subject: biology
title: Cell structure: animal vs plant
description: Organelles with labels: 1 membrane · 2 nucleus · 3 nucleolus · 4 RER · 5 Golgi · 6 mitochondrion · 7 lysosome · 8 centrioles · 9 wall · 10 vacuole · 11 chloroplast.

subject: biology
title: Surface area : volume ratio
description: SA/V = 6/L for a cube: why cells stay small.

subject: biology
title: Mitosis: stages of cell division
description: Interphase → prophase → metaphase → anaphase → telophase → cytokinesis (2n = 4).

subject: biology
title: Enzyme kinetics (Michaelis–Menten)
description: v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]); a competitive inhibitor raises the apparent Km.

subject: biology
title: Osmosis across a membrane (engine)
description: Water moves toward the higher solute concentration until hydrostatic pressure balances.

subject: biology
title: Monohybrid cross (Punnett square)
description: Parent genotypes 0 AA · 1 Aa · 2 aa; complete or incomplete dominance (red × white → pink).

subject: biology
title: Dihybrid cross (9 : 3 : 3 : 1)
description: Two independently assorting genes; AaBb × AaBb gives 9 : 3 : 3 : 1.

subject: biology
title: Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium
description: p² + 2pq + q² = 1 for allele frequencies p and q.

subject: biology
title: DNA double helix
description: Antiparallel strands, complementary base pairing, 10 bp per turn (3.4 nm).

subject: biology
title: Translation: codons → amino acids
description: The ribosome reads mRNA codon by codon from AUG to a stop codon, building the polypeptide.

subject: biology
title: Photosynthesis & limiting factors
description: Rate limited by light, CO₂ or temperature (Blackman); count O₂ bubbles from Hydrilla.

subject: biology
title: Water potential & plasmolysis
description: Water moves from higher to lower ψ; in hypertonic solution the protoplast shrinks.

subject: biology
title: Cardiac cycle & cardiac output
description: CO = HR × SV; ventricular volume falls in systole and refills in diastole.

subject: biology
title: Nerve impulse & action potential
description: The impulse travels along the axon; the electrode at the middle records the action potential.

subject: biology
title: Oxygen–haemoglobin dissociation curve
description: Sigmoid Hill curve; higher CO₂, H⁺ or temperature raise P₅₀ (Bohr shift to the right).

subject: biology
title: Blood glucose regulation by insulin (engine)
description: After a meal glucose rises; insulin secretion brings it back (negative feedback).

subject: biology
title: Population growth: exponential vs logistic (engine)
description: dN/dt = rN (J-curve) or rN(1 − N/K) (S-curve, carrying capacity K).

equations.expression: model == 1 ? r N : r N (1 - N/K)

subject: biology
title: Predator–prey (Lotka–Volterra, engine)
description: Prey: αx − βxy · Predators: δxy − γy. Oscillations lag a quarter cycle.

subject: biology
title: Energy flow: ecological pyramid
description: Lindeman's 10 % law: energy available at each trophic level.

subject: biology
title: Natural selection: peppered moth (engine)
description: On soot-darkened bark, birds eat light moths; the dark allele rises over generations.

subject: biology
title: PCR amplification
description: Copies = N₀(1 + E)ⁿ: exponential doubling with each cycle.

subject: biology
title: Gel electrophoresis
description: DNA (negative) moves to the anode; smaller fragments travel farther (∝ −log size).
